hebrewText: וְ/גַם עֵ֥רֶב רַ֖ב עָלָ֣ה אִתָּ֑/ם וְ/צֹ֣אן וּ/בָקָ֔ר מִקְנֶ֖ה כָּבֵ֥ד מְאֹֽד

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
tokens.kjv: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

tokens.bdb: the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race)
abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.bdb: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanation: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively

tokens.bdb: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd
tokens.kjv: beeve, bull ([phrase] -ock), [phrase] calf, [phrase] cow, great (cattle), [phrase] heifer, herd, kine, ox.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender ; collectively
tokens.enLiteralWord: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender ; collectively
tokens.explanation: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender ; collectively
tokens.explanationEn: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender ; collectively

tokens.bdb: something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition
tokens.kjv: cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.

tokens.bdb: heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid)
tokens.kjv: (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: heavy; figuratively in a good sense  or in a bad sense (severe
tokens.enLiteralWord: heavy; figuratively in a good sense  or in a bad sense (severe
tokens.explanation: heavy; figuratively in a good sense  or in a bad sense (severe
tokens.explanationEn: heavy; figuratively in a good sense  or in a bad sense (severe

tokens.bdb: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
tokens.kjv: diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), [idiom] louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very ([phrase] much, sore), well.
